component.name: Link Studio
component.summary: Native Linux controller for Insta360 Link webcams

description.p: Link Studio provides live preview and capture, safe hardware camera controls, local AI effects and tracking, audio processing modes, scenes, a teleprompter, and phone and global remote control for Insta360 Link webcams.

screenshot.caption: Link Studio controlling an Insta360 Link 2 with preview disabled

description.p: Reliable user-scope installation with pre-existing hicolor icon trees.
Dedicated multiresolution application icon and distribution integration.
Documentation redesign and distribution-neutral Arch setup helpers.
Correctness, concurrency, privacy, preview-color, and global-shortcut fixes.
First production release, hardware-tested with Insta360 Link 2 on Arch Linux.
